reference.description: re-computes the Renyi entropy with NeuroKit2 entropy_renyi across alpha = {0.5, 1, 2, 3} on the identical amplitude histogram; reports the collision (alpha=2) and Shannon (alpha=1) entropies, the bit-exact NeuroKit2 agreement over the family, the bin count, and whether the family is monotonically decreasing in alpha
